artist.name: Big M
artist.bio: Big M (Mrunal Shah) is a Mumbai-based DJ and curator whose sets centre on house, with UKG, jungle, hip-hop and disco in the mix. In 2020 he started Q-Radio, an online radio platform begun during lockdown that now gives emerging DJs a place to play, and he runs it with Vansh. He has played a Monsoon Mixtapes show on Refuge Worldwide in Berlin.

press.title: Mix Of The Day: BIG M
